stage: exposed nine-state development; frozen before native-orbital reference predictions
reason: implement the requested separation: native GFN2 spatial ground orbitals, DFT orbital-energy reference, then spin-pure orbital optimization with the ground-state program
parent_response: unchanged prepared CAM-B3LYP charge/spin kernel, lambda=0.9, standard omega=0.33
F_reference: diagonal Rayleigh quotients of the embedded DFT Fock in the native canonical GFN2 orbitals; discard off-diagonal one-body mixing
Q_reference: qualified full DFT orbital levels matched separately in occupied and virtual spaces to the same native GFN2 orbitals; overlap>=0.7 and margin>=0.05, unmatched levels use F_reference
Q_safety_rule: if the molecular occupied/virtual spectral gap is nonpositive, use F_reference for every Q level of that molecule; no state-dependent selection
common_functional: one averaged F/Q one-body field with weights 0.5/0.5; re-center the quadratic charge term at the native ground density
native_ground: must remain stationary with positive restricted orbital curvature and unchanged occupied projector; otherwise reject the candidate
excited_states: unchanged ground-orthogonal spin-pure ROKS and Q-projected NOSI with paired doubles
comparison: complete singlet TDA of this identical functional on the same native GFN2 spatial orbitals, including the correct range-separated exchange tensor
nuclear_derivatives: same complete analytic frozen-response and projected-NOSI response implementation; revalidate the final reference choice
